title: Bathys: Advancing Deep Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.32660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep search is a critical capability for agents tackling complex, open-ended tasks, where solving a problem requires iterative information gathering, query reformulation, and evidence-based verification rather than a single retrieval step. To address these requirements, we present Bathys 9B and 27B deep search agents built around a training framework that spans verifiable question synthesis, post-training, and online reinforcement learning (RL) under context compression. Our high-quality data construction ensures both search depth and reliability: each clue is reformulated as an indirect reference requiring independent retrieval, and retained evidence chains enable verification that the clues jointly determine a unique answer. Curated trajectories underpin a pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO), and Compaction-Managed Group Sequence Policy Optimization (CM-GSPO): SFT provides a stable foundation

translated_title: Bathys：深度搜索智能体的进阶
translated_abstract: 深度搜索是智能体应对复杂、开放式任务的关键能力，在这类任务中，解决问题需要迭代式的信息收集、查询重构以及基于证据的验证，而非单次检索步骤。为满足这些需求，我们提出了 Bathys 9B 和 Bathys 27B 两个深度搜索智能体，其训练框架涵盖可验证的问题合成、后训练以及上下文压缩下的在线强化学习（RL）。我们高质量的数据构建确保了搜索深度与可靠性：每条线索都被改写为需要独立检索的间接指代，并保留证据链以便验证这些线索共同确定唯一答案。经过精心整理的轨迹数据支撑了一个由监督微调（SFT）、Kahneman-Tversky 优化（KTO）以及压缩管理组序列策略优化（CM-GSPO）组成的训练流水线：SFT 提供了稳定的基础……
tldr: 提出 Bathys 9B 和 27B 深度搜索智能体，通过可验证问题合成、SFT/KTO/CM-GSPO 训练流水线以及上下文压缩下的在线强化学习框架，提升智能体在复杂开放式任务中迭代检索与证据验证的能力。
en_tdlr: We present Bathys 9B and 27B deep search agents, built on a training framework spanning verifiable question synthesis, an SFT/KTO/CM-GSPO pipeline, and online RL under context compression, to advance agents' capabilities in iterative information gathering and evidence-based verification for complex open-ended tasks.
